name: A government-bond loss counts at 48.08% against share gains
workings: Government-bond loss 10,000.00 − 9,000.00 = 1,000.00, taxed at 12.5% when a gain, so it counts at 12.5 / 26 = 48.08%: 480.77
Share gain 500.00 less 480.77 = 19.23, taxed at 26% = 5.00 (the 1,000.00 loss saves 125.00, what it would have paid as a gain)
